title: View: File list rendering (icon + name rows in Nuklear)
acceptance_criteria: File list panel created with nk_group_begin() for scrollable area
Each row renders: icon glyph (16x16) + file/folder name + size + date
Icon rendered from glyph cache bitmap via Nuklear image widget
Folder entries use folder icon, file entries use extension-based icon
Selected row highlighted with distinct background color
Rows sorted: directories first (alphabetical), then files (alphabetical)
Row height consistent (24px) with proper vertical alignment
List renders 100 entries without visual artifacts or performance issues
